notes: Cloudflare Managed Challenge, 403. Body is 5.9KB decompressed (3.3KB on the wire) of inline CSS and a Turnstile mount point.

distinguishing_from: vs tandfonline_cf_challenge: SAME vendor, SAME Cf-Mitigated header, DIFFERENT title string (One moment please vs Just a moment). Title-string matching alone will miss one of the two.
notes: Kept specifically to break brittle title-only Cloudflare detectors.

distinguishing_from: Third DataDome instance, 1707 bytes, 50 visible-text chars. Confirms the DataDome body template is host-independent, so vendor detection generalizes while host heuristics do not.
notes: Also carries a Cloudflare __cf_bm cookie in the same response: two bot vendors stacked on one request. Do not assume one wall per response.

distinguishing_from: THE STATUS-CODE TRAP: HTTP 202 Accepted. Any classifier that treats 2xx as success and only inspects 4xx/5xx for walls will pass this straight through as a real page.
notes: AWS WAF challenge served via CloudFront. x-amzn-waf-action: challenge is also listed in Access-Control-Expose-Headers, so it is visible to browser JS. Fourth distinct bot vendor in this corpus.
